description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode I (Gau)], [Dual Wildling Life Mode] and [Celerity/Combat Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode I (Gau)
description.text: Combat and Celerity abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Celerity and Combat abilities trigger 2 additional times

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode II (Gau)], removes [Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode I (Gau)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode II (Gau)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Combat and Celerity abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Combat and Celerity abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Celerity and Combat abilities, critical chance =100%

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Dual Wildling Life Mode
description.text: Randomly casts Dual Barbarity, Dual Explosive Thrust or Dual Scratch after using a Combat or Celerity ability, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Bestial Power Mode I (Gau)]

description.name: Celerity/Combat Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Celerity and Combat abilities deal 5% more damage
